_comment: Where to download each step's container image from, for LOCAL deployment
(see engine/local_bundle.py and docs/local-deployment.md). Keyed by Tapis
app id; the exporter maps each to the <app-id>.sif filename the runner
looks for, and the runner downloads it once into --images-dir and reuses
the file on every later run.
Only needed for steps whose container is NOT built from this repo's
jobs/*/*.def. Steps that stage their own .sif as a fileInput (training,
inference, preprocessing) already carry their URL in their step.json and
NOTE: a Tapis postit redeem URL is a capability link - anyone holding it
can download that file, and it is copied into every exported bundle. Set
WF_IMAGE_SOURCES to an alternate file path to keep them out of the repo.
Links are typically use-limited or expiring, which is exactly why the
runner caches the .sif rather than redeeming on every run.
